128418: Kazuma Fujioka is a 4th-year student at Rikudo Univesity. He is a running prodigy and famous among intercollegiate Track meets and races. He is the captain of Rikudo University Track and Field team. He knew Haiji prior to his knee injury and becomes a target for Kakeru to defeat.
128420: Nira lives in Aotake house with ten male college students and one elderly man. He often joins his housemates for their daily running practice. He's also the eye catch in the middle of Run With The Wind, which means that he's a welcome diversion when things get too intense.
128421: Sakaki was a member of Kakeru's high school Track and Field team. He developed an eternal grudge towards Kakeru after causing an incident that affected their entire team. He is a first-year student at Tokyo Sports University.
128422: Genichirō Tazaki is the landlord of Chikuseisou and the official coach of the team. He is an old man with thick eyebrows and a beard. He always wears a red hat. He was once known as the treasure of the Japan Association of Athletics.
128424: Kakeru has short, straight black hair and slate-colored eyes. When he runs, the wind pushes his hair to the back. He has a lean and athletic build that was developed over the years of competitive running.
128425: Haiji Kiyose is a 4th year literature student in Kansei University Student and a long time resident of Chikuseisou. He is the resident of room 101 of Chikuseisou. He has a friendly and outgoing personality, but underneath has a bit of a manipulative side.
128551: Takashi Sugiyama is a third-year business student at Kansei University. He is the resident of room 205 at Chikuseisou. Generally considered an honor student by the other residents of Chikuseisou, Takashi is an earnest student from the Yamagata Prefecture- a mountainy region.
128552: Jirō Jō is a 1st-year economics student at Kansei University. He is the younger twin brother of Tarō Jō. He is a resident of room 201 at Chikuseisou. Joji has a yellow spiky hair. He is often seen wearing a necklace and a long sleeve shirt underneath a yellow shirt and shorts.
128553: Tarō Jō is a 1st-year economics student at Kansei Univeristy. He is the older twin brother of Jirō Jō. He is a resident of room 201 at Chikuseisou. He and his brother played soccer for three years in high school.
128554: Yukihiko Iwakura is one of the Aotake runners. He is a 4th-year law student at Kansei University and the resident of room 102 at Chikuseisou. Yuki is a rather slim yet lean young man. His skin is a pale peach color. He has side-swept black hair and an undercut.
128555: Musa is a native to Tanzania. He moved to Japan to study Space and Engineering as a sponsored international student at Kansei University. His Japanese still has flaws leading to some misunderstandings and written mistakes.
128556: Akihiro Hirata is a 3rd-year science and engineering student at Kansei University. Hirata is resident of room 104 at Chikuseiso. Nico is the tallest among the Aotake runners with a muscular statue.
128557: Nicknamed "Prince" because of his good looks, Prince is a 2nd year literature student at Kansei University. He is most notably known for having copious amounts of manga in his room and being the slowest runner in the group with the most unique running style.
128558: Known as Hana-chan to the members of Chikuseisou, she is a 3rd year high school student and daughter of one of the shop owners in the local shopping district. At Haiji's request, Hanako rode her bike alongside the team and also times their runs.
128560: Yōhei Sakaguchi is one of the Aotake runners. Known as 'King' due to his love of trivia, Yohei is a 4th year Sociology student at Kansei University. He is the resident of room 205 at Chikuseisou. He has a buzz cut, a large nose, and black eyes.
